walkthrough: As s147-progress, the system in Chinese: 复测 · 第 1 单元, 哪张更好 with 左边好 · 差不多 · 右边好, dates as 10月6日, the book's 日历 and 进步, each word read on the screens.

Goal: see whether my drawing gets better, judged by my own eye, without the app scoring me: compare two of my earlier copies blind now and then, see each skill's curve in the practice book, and redo a unit's re-test to put its start and its end side by side.
Monday 5 October, the first lesson (a scribble, a straight line, an arc), Finish, That's all for today.

Tuesday: unit 1's re-test at its start (复测 · 第 1 单元; the path offers it from unit 2 on, a walk starts it here): one line, one group of lines, one colour, each the first level's. I copy the line, Compare, Accurate; the group, Compare, Almost; I fill the colour, Compare (the app's verdict). Finish: its end, the bar Re-test · lesson done, no pair (nothing to compare it with yet). Then a lesson of Lines: the first line copied, compared, Accurate; Next to the end, Finish: no pair either.
Four weeks later (29 days in), a lesson of Lines: the first line copied, Compare, Almost; Finish: still no pair (no copy of the last two weeks to set against an older one).

A week later (day 36), a lesson of Lines: the first line, Compare, Accurate, Next to the end, Finish. The end card: the results, the dots, then under a rule Which is better over two of my earlier lines side by side, the same size, each as its first Compare showed it (the original in see-through red, my ink over it), no date, no mark, sides random; under them Left better, Same, Right better. Not today's copy: the newer is day 29's, the older day 1's. No sentence anywhere.

Left better: the buttons go, each card's date shows under it (the newer's in ink, the older's quieter), the left card outlined. Skipping would have stored nothing; tapping again does nothing. That's all for today.

The same day, unit 1's re-test at its end: the same three tasks as on day 1. Line Accurate, group Accurate, colour filled and compared. Finish: under the results Lines named over its two copies (day 1's start and today's), blind; Right better: its dates show, its result marks before them, and Combined lines' pair comes; Same; then Colours'; Left better. All three revealed.

Home, Practice book: the calendar page as before (the first and latest lines, the seals). Progress (进步) at the top right: one chart a skill practised, in course order: Lines, Combined lines, Colours, each its name over an ink line from its first day to its last with a pale wash around it, a long gap drawn as a short break on the baseline, the first and last dates under the ends, no axis, no number, no legend; beside each chart the re-test's two copies, dated, Re-test under them. Calendar goes back to the calendar.
Not here: a confident fall's extra drill (the app's flow tests), the home's re-test row once a unit's seal is earned (the app's flow tests), a reopened lesson's pair (the app's flow tests).
